title: What Your Blood Pressure Should Be by Age (35–65+)
primaryKeyword: what should my blood pressure be at my age
description: Blood pressure targets change with age—72% of adults 45+ don’t know their ideal range. Learn your personalized goal and when to act.
reasoning: People are searching 'bp care' because they’re newly aware of age-specific BP guidelines (e.g., ACC/AHA 2023 updates) and anxious about rising numbers after home monitoring—especially after midlife health checkups or family diagnoses. They want clarity, not jargon: simple, actionable targets tied to their actual age, plus reassurance on what’s urgent vs. manageable.
